source.title: An integrated multimodal pan-organ atlas of the female reproductive system across the lifespan contextualises gynaecological pathologies
source.atlas_name: Human Female Reproductive System Cell Atlas v1

_provenance.note: First-pass catalogue. scope derived from CL-mapping source_sheet (*_fetal -> fetal, else adult/postnatal). granularity set to 'fine' for all (Supp Table 2B is the fine-grained tier); broad/lineage tiers captured in lineage_L1/L2/L3/L4. Paper reports 210 fine cell types; table lists more rows because some are prenatal-specific or scope-split.

annotations.label: Gonadal_rete_Fetal_Undiff
annotations.L3: Gonadal supporting rete ovarii and testes precursor
annotations.description: Epithelium of the rete ovarii — a network of epithelial cords in the ovarian hilum derived from mesonephric tubules that connects to the ovarian follicles. PAX8+, mixed Müllerian/mesonephric character. Undifferentiated L4 assigned because the fetal rete ovarii has not yet acquired its adult tubular structure. Clinically relevant: the rete ovarii is the putative origin of some serous cystadenomas and Wolffian adnexal tumours. L2 = Secretory epithelial as default for this tubular epithelial structure; review if markers suggest otherwise.

annotations.label: Immune_CD4_Th17_SCMlike
annotations.description: Express Th17 markers, but also markers of both naive and memory T cells, which is consistent with a TSCM phenotype (Wang et al., 2021). Contains a small IL22+ subset.
annotations.cl_term_label: stem cell memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell

annotations.label: Immune_CD4_Treg
annotations.cl_term_label: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell

annotations.label: Immune_CD8_NaiveT

annotations.label: Immune_CD8_T_EM
annotations.description: CX3CR1, KLRG1, GZMB, and perforin expression is consistent with a TEMRA phenotype, poised for rapid cytolytic activity (Masopust et al., 2026). Contains a subset that is enriched in menstural fluid and is SELL+ - this might be more central memory-like.
annotations.cl_term_label: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive

annotations.label: Immune_CD8_T_RM
annotations.description: A portion of this cluster expresses GZMB, but not GZMK.

annotations.label: Immune_CD8_T_RM_GZMKhi
annotations.description: Downregulates canonical tissue-resident memory markers relative to CD8_T_RM cluster. Expresses GZMK, but not GZMB.

annotations.label: Immune_HPC
annotations.description: Lack of GATA1 expression indicates that theses have not yet committed to megakaryocyte/erythroid lineage.

annotations.label: Immune_ILC3_NCRhi
annotations.cl_term_label: NKp44-positive group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human

annotations.label: Immune_ILC3_NCRlo
annotations.description: NCR2 expression is lower compared to ILC3_NCRhi.
annotations.cl_term_label: NKp44-negative group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human

annotations.label: Immune_ImmatureB
annotations.description: IKZF2 expression is lower.

annotations.label: Immune_LargePreB
annotations.description: DNTT, RAG1/2 expression is lower. Cycling.

annotations.label: Immune_LateErythroid
annotations.description: Compared to EarlyMidErythroid, exhibits lower expression of GATA1, KLF1 and higher expression of BPGM.

annotations.label: Immune_MAIT
annotations.description: Two potential states: CA10+, GZMK-, and GZMK+, CA10-. Expresses several tissue-residency markers (ITGAE, ITGA1, CXCR6).

annotations.label: Immune_MEMP
annotations.description: A cluster of adult HPCs, which are GATA1+, reside within this cluster, suggesting that they might be transitioning towards a megakaryocyte/erythroid fate.

annotations.label: Immune_Mac_Transitional
annotations.description: Heterogeneous population lacking specific markers.

annotations.label: Immune_NKT_γδT_Vδ1
annotations.description: Expresses several tissue-residency markers (ITGAE, ITGA1, CXCR6).

annotations.label: Immune_NK_CD16hi
annotations.description: CD56 expression is low.
annotations.cl_term_label: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human

annotations.label: Immune_NK_CD56dim_CD16dim_SPTSSBhi
annotations.description: Both CD56 and CD16 expression are low. High SELL and IL7R expression compared to the other NK subsets suggests this is a more progenitor-like state.

annotations.label: Immune_NMP_Promyelocytes
annotations.description: MS4A3, MPO expression are suggestive of NMP. PRTN3, ELANE, and CTSG expression suggest promyelocyte.

annotations.label: Immune_ProB
annotations.description: Contains both early and late pro-B cells.

annotations.label: Immune_SmallPreB
annotations.description: LEF1 expression is lower.

annotations.label: Immune_mregDC
annotations.description: DC subset, described by Maier et al., 2020, that co-expresses immunoregulatory molecules and maturation genes. This programme is upregulated by cDC1/2 upon the uptake of tumour antigens.

annotations.label: Immune_tolDC
annotations.description: DC subset characterised by co-expression of transcription factors PRDM16 and RORC. Fu et al. first identified tolDCs as crucial for inducing peripheral Tregs against foreign antigens derived from food and commensal microbiota within the gastrointestinal tract.
